dataset.title: Replication Data for: High Gain Operational Amplifier Using Enhancement and Depletion Mode a-IGZO TFTs

verified_conditions.drain_bias_basis: Figure 1 in the linked paper labels U_D = 10 V
verified_conditions.channel_thickness_basis: Filename has 120nm; official Figure 1 Script.py maps sorted YO10 files to thickness array value 122.6 nm
verified_conditions.top_gate_insulator_basis: linked paper fabrication section; reference script also uses d=130 nm in its gate-capacitance estimate

unknown_or_not_fully_confirmed: The publication and plotting script do not clearly identify whether the recorded UG sweep is applied to the top gate or bottom gate.
Relative permittivity 4 is an assumption in the reference script; the paper does not specify it as a measured value for this sample.

The reference script's capacitance formula uses a single 130 nm layer, while the paper also describes a bottom dielectric stack of 175 nm SiN plus 50 nm SiOx; the correct capacitance model for the specific UG terminal is not resolved by these files.
The dataset does not establish whether suffixes _1, _2, and _3 are repeated sweeps of one device or measurements from separate devices.

field_interpretation.column_1: Gate voltage UG in V; based on variable Ugate and Figure 1 axis/description
field_interpretation.column_2: Drain current ID in A; based on variable Idrain and Figure 1 axis/description
field_interpretation.sweep: -20.0 V to 19.8 V in 0.2 V increments for the checked sample
